fusions.name: Drawn Venom
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Fires a bolt that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Purging Shrug
fusions.desc: You shrug the poison out of your plate, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 2.5 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You restore 6 health.

fusions.name: Bitter Lining
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it, and your poison resistance rises by 20%.

fusions.name: Mithridate Temper
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they spend at once and you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
